name: proof.memoryIndexOpAssignUnfoldLeftFst.receiver-capture-bypassed.1
diff:
--- a/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
@@ -579,3 +579,3 @@
   | memoryIndexOpAssignUnfoldLeftFst :
-      dl{ ⟨[ nmp[ie] ⊕= se; ]⟩ ⇝ ⟨[ T memory mv = nmp; mv[ie] ⊕= se; ]⟩ }
+      dl{ ⟨[ nmp[ie] ⊕= se; ]⟩ ⇝ ⟨[ nmp[ie] ⊕= se; ]⟩ }
   | compoundAssignValueRhsCapture :

diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.memoryIndexOpAssignUnfoldLeftFst: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.loc l✝) ie✝) (Val.simple se✝))
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.unfold
    (Prog.cons (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.loc l✝) ie✝) (Val.simple se✝)) Prog.nil) Ext.refl

case loc
C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
op✝ : BinOp
hop✝ : op✝.hasCompoundAssign = true
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ : RefTy
mk✝ : ArrTy x✝ (Ty.prim p✝)
ie✝ : Simple C✝ Γ✝ PrimTy.uint
se✝ : Simple C✝ Γ✝ p✝
l✝ : MLoc C✝ Γ✝ (Ty.ref x✝)
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.loc l✝) ie✝) (Val.simple se✝)) =
    Premise.unfold
      (Prog.cons (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.loc l✝) ie✝) (Val.simple se✝)) Prog.nil) Ext.refl
